svg.aria-label: Solution architecture: agent clients sign in with Microsoft Entra ID and call the MCP server on Azure Container Apps, which calls an internal dealer API with a key from Key Vault and writes an audit line per call to Log Analytics.
svg.text: any MCP host over Streamable HTTP
VS Code and Azure CLI pre-authorized
Bicep at subscription scope, deployed with azd
one JSON audit line per tool call:
caller ID. Never values or tokens.
Min 1 replica per app, health probes on /healthz. One image, two entry points (APP_ENTRY).
The DMS key reaches the server only as a Key Vault reference; the model never sees it.
